subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Kestrel — status + extrapolation-range trade-off
body:
Hi both,

Status: the pretrained model is reproduced and Rosa's demo path renders the sway trajectory from our own dual-lens captures — it genuinely impresses in person. Maren's intrinsics-refinement pass works; calibration drift on the capture rigs is now correctable in preprocessing.

The trade-off we need a decision on: extrapolation range. Within ~4x the input baseline, renders are clean. The capture team's product spec asks for wider sweeps (~8x), and out there the MPI's fixed depth planes show their limits — we get visible stack-of-cards artifacts and edge smearing on foreground occluders in roughly a quarter of test scenes. Retraining on internal captures (starting next week on the 128-GPU allocation) should help texture realism but won't change the geometry limits; that's inherent to the plane parameterization.

Options for the Jun 29 review: (a) demo locked at 4x — reliably beautiful; (b) 8x with a scene-screening step. I lean (a).

Rafael
